raw_blocks: Founded in 1989, Integra LifeSciences is a global medical technology leader dedicated to restoring lives. We are advancing transformational care through impactful innovation in neurosurgery and tissue reconstruction, specialized fields that demand exceptional expertise and precision. Our portfolio of highly differentiated gold-standard products and solutions is built on decades of clinical evidence and trusted by healthcare professionals to improve patient outcomes.
Dr. Richard Caruso founded Integra LifeSciences and the company acquired collagen technology.
Integra® Dermal Regeneration Template approved by the FDA and is engineered to promote the regeneration of dermal tissue.
Leveraging its tissue regeneration technology, Integra received FDA clearance of DuraGen® Dural Graft Matrix for use as a dura substitute for the repair of the dura mater.
NeuraGen® Nerve Guide is FDA cleared and provides a protective environment across nerve discontinuities.
Integra acquired Jarit® Surgical Instruments and enters the specialty surgical instruments market.
Integra acquired SurgiMend® Collagen Matrix for Soft Tissue Reconstruction with a broad range of applications from hernia repair to plastic and reconstructive surgery.
Acquired the Codman® Neurosurgery business and became the global leader of neurosurgical products.
Acquired MicroMatrix® UBM Particulate for acute and chronic wounds, and Gentrix® Surgical Matrix for soft tissue repair.
Acquired DuraSorb® Monofilament Mesh, a bioabsorbable matrix for the reinforcement of soft tissue.
Acquired Acclarent, Inc., a pioneer in ear, nose and throat (ENT) surgical interventions.

pages.raw_meta: Integra offers extensive expertise in collagen biomaterials for companies seeking strategic alliances. Our collagen products are manufactured from bovine deep flexor tendon, one of the purest sources of Type 1 collagen available, with biocompatibility and safety demonstrated in over 10 million implants (neurosurgery, plastic and reconstructive surgery and orthopedic surgery). Integra is a recognized and respected industry leader with vast experience in developing innovative regenerative products with a wide array of applications, including dental applications, sports medicine, bone grafting materials, reconstructive wound healing, hemostasis and carrier technologies for drug and protein delivery.

Our collagen products are manufactured from bovine deep flexor tendon, one of the purest sources of Type 1 collagen available, with biocompatibility and safety demonstrated in over 10 million implants (neurosurgery, plastic and reconstructive surgery and orthopedic surgery). Integra is a recognized and respected industry leader with vast experience in developing innovative regenerative products with a wide array of applications, including dental applications, sports medicine, bone grafting materials, reconstructive wound healing, hemostasis and carrier technologies for drug and protein delivery.

Integra is compliant with ISO 13485:2016, FDA Quality Systems Regulations and the (EU) 2017/745 Medical Device Regulations. Our wealth of experience in design control, testing requirements, manufacturing, quality systems and the regulatory approval process makes us a powerful partner to companies seeking:
A private label partner: Integra manufactures products that are available for private label distribution by our customers
A material supplier: Integra produces raw materials that can be integrated into our customer's production processes
Customer-specific product development: Integra has the expertise to design, develop and manufacture products to meet the specific needs of our customers
For complete product information, please see the Instructions for Use accompanying each product.

Bioengineering with Ultra Pure Collagen ™
Integra LifeSciences controls the physical and chemical composition to ensure each product is designed with attributes critical for biological/physiological activity.
Provides a scaffold for cellular ingrowth
Affords excellent handling and conformability
Engineered with defined mechanical strength, porosity and degradation rate
Custom shapes and sizes available
Carrier technologies for drug/protein delivery
